credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.name: Name
credentials.gitDescription: Credentials for build nodes fetching private Git repositories. Stored encrypted, never displayed again after saving.
credentials.registryDescription: Credentials for pushing images and pulling private images on publish. Stored encrypted, never displayed again after saving.
credentials.gitAddressHint: Optional; identifies the Git service this credential is for.
credentials.createNote: The payload is write-only: it is stored encrypted and can never be read back.
credentials.editNote: Editing replaces the stored description and payload in one atomic update; secrets cannot be read back, so re-enter all secret material.
credentials.deleteDescription: Workflows referencing this credential name will fail to build until reconfigured.
credentials.payloadRequired: Fill in the git or registry credential fields.

buildProviders.title: Build Providers
buildProviders.description: k8s build providers created from kite's managed clusters; they join the build fleet at runtime, without config changes or restarts.
buildProviders.name: Name
buildProviders.nameHint: DNS-1123 label; unique across the build fleet.
buildProviders.nameImmutableHint: The name is immutable; workflows reference providers by name.
buildProviders.namespaceHint: Namespace receiving the buildkitd runtime pods.
buildProviders.nameInvalid: Name must be a DNS-1123 label (lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 63 chars max).
buildProviders.namespaceInvalid: Namespace must be a DNS-1123 label (lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 63 chars max).
buildProviders.runtimeHint: Build runtime profile; default is the built-in profile.
buildProviders.cpuInvalid: CPU limit must be a positive number.
buildProviders.memoryInvalid: Memory limit must be a positive number (Gi).
buildProviders.podSpecHint: CPU / memory of the build pod when a workflow leaves capacity empty.
buildProviders.podCpuInvalid: Instance CPU must be a non-negative number.
buildProviders.podMemoryInvalid: Instance memory must be a non-negative number (Gi).
buildProviders.cacheHint: The GC schedule is a cron expression; image and size are required, StorageClass is optional. Unchecking skips the cache registry entirely.
buildProviders.cacheRequired: An enabled cache requires image, size and GC schedule.
buildProviders.readyTimeoutHint: Optional; empty keeps the module default.
buildProviders.readyTimeoutInvalid: Ready timeout must be a non-negative integer.
buildProviders.notConfigured: buildfleet is not configured; add a buildfleet section to the kite config first.
buildProviders.deleteDescription: The provider is unregistered from the build fleet immediately; builds pinning it fail at run time until reconfigured.
buildProviders.deleteReferenced: Referenced by {{count}} namespace default(s); those builds will fail at run time until reconfigured.

buildRuntime.title: Build Runtime
buildRuntime.description: Node hosts, insecure registries and mirror mappings of the default runtime profile.
buildRuntime.hostsHint: Statically resolve hostnames to the given IP.
buildRuntime.insecureHint: Entries must start with http:// or https://.
buildRuntime.restartNote: Changes take full effect for docker / config-file providers after a restart.
buildRuntime.hostsRequired: Each host entry needs an IP and at least one hostname.
buildRuntime.insecureInvalid: Insecure registry entries must start with http:// or https://.
buildRuntime.mirrorsRequired: Each mirror needs a source registry and at least one mirror source.
buildRuntime.loadFailed: Build runtime settings are unavailable; buildfleet may not be configured.
